name: Universal Business Formulas
description: The baseline formula set every business needs, independent of domain: margin and pricing, break-even, tax arithmetic, receivables, liquidity, the cash conversion cycle, depreciation and growth. Carries no jurisdiction-specific rate - every rate is an input the caller supplies. Intended as the starting point a new domain kit is built on top of.
author: Cerebrum
_flow_note: Declared, not inferred. Neither block feeds the other and either is a valid entry point. Note formula_executor_v2 does NOT read this kit's data file -- it is an LLM code-generation block; the formula set is a definitions catalogue to check generated work against, not an input it loads. See README.
